findings.issue: The root README's deep-loop section, added in this range, says the expansive frontier 'turns a stop into another pass while one stays open, though never past the iteration cap'. The iteration cap is named as the only limit, but the max-duration stop also beats the veto. In deep-research.yaml, step_check_max_duration sets STOP/maxDurationReached and skip_to: phase_synthesis whether or not a node is open. deep-research convergence.md:70 and deep-review SKILL.md:222 both list 'the max-duration stop' among the stops the veto never outranks. Case: an operator starts an expansive run with the default 120-minute budget and a large frontier, reads the README and expects it to keep going until the iteration cap. It stops at 120 minutes with nodes still open. This is the same omission C1-3 records for deep-research changelog v1.16.0.0, here in a different file the lanes did not flag. Lane C3 reviewed README.md and reported nothing on it.

evidence.cmd: grep -n 'never past the iteration cap' README.md; grep -n -A3 'if_reached:' .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research.yaml | sed -n 1,4p; grep -n 'the max-duration stop' .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/deep-research/references/convergence/convergence.md .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/deep-review/SKILL.md
evidence.out: README.md:255 ... turns a stop into another pass while one stays open, though never past the iteration cap. | deep-research.yaml step_check_max_duration if_reached: set { decision: STOP, reason: maxDurationReached } ... skip_to: phase_synthesis | convergence.md:70 and deep-review SKILL.md:222: never outranks the iteration cap, consecutive failures, stuck recovery, pause, the max-duration stop, ...

fix.old: turns a stop into another pass while one stays open, though never past the iteration cap.
fix.new: turns a stop into another pass while one stays open, though never past the iteration cap or the run's time budget.
